{
  "dataset_name": "2dplanes",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "sum_all_features",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Linear sum across all 10 input features; provides a simple linear projection useful as an SVM margin baseline.",
      "value_range": [-10.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "linear_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Directly aligns with linear hyperplane structure in input space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 + x7 + x8 + x9 + x10"
    },
    {
      "name": "x1_weighted_sum_rest",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "x1 multiplied by the sum of the other features, encoding interaction between the highest-variance feature and the rest.",
      "value_range": [-9.0, 9.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures multiplicative structure that linear SVM cannot capture from raw features alone.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "x1 * (x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 + x7 + x8 + x9 + x10)"
    },
    {
      "name": "x1_sign_times_magnitude_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sign of x1 multiplied by sum of absolute values of the other features; smooth severity-like score.",
      "value_range": [-9.0, 9.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a directional severity composite for linear margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(x1 >= 0, 1.0, -1.0) * (np.abs(x2) + np.abs(x3) + np.abs(x4) + np.abs(x5) + np.abs(x6) + np.abs(x7) + np.abs(x8) + np.abs(x9) + np.abs(x10))"
    },
    {
      "name": "abs_x1",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Magnitude of x1; continuous severity measure for the most variable input.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows linear SVM to learn nonlinear relationship between x1 magnitude and outcome.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(x1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "mean_abs_features",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average magnitude across all input features; smooth normalized aggregate.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregate_magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous summary that complements signed linear combinations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.abs(x1) + np.abs(x2) + np.abs(x3) + np.abs(x4) + np.abs(x5) + np.abs(x6) + np.abs(x7) + np.abs(x8) + np.abs(x9) + np.abs(x10)) / 10.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "positive_feature_count_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of features with positive value across the 10 inputs.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the directional balance of features as a normalized linear-friendly score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(x1 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x2 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x3 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x4 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x5 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x6 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x7 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x8 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x9 > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x10 > 0, 1.0, 0.0)) / 10.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "x1_x2_product",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Pairwise interaction between x1 and x2.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds explicit nonlinear interaction lift to a linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "x1 * x2"
    },
    {
      "name": "x1_x3_product",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Pairwise interaction between x1 and x3.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds another explicit nonlinear interaction term for SVM separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "x1 * x3"
    },
    {
      "name": "sqrt_sumsq_features",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean norm of the 10-dimensional row vector; smooth global magnitude.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.163],
      "feature_family": "magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous norm useful as a margin-scaling auxiliary feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(x1*x1 + x2*x2 + x3*x3 + x4*x4 + x5*x5 + x6*x6 + x7*x7 + x8*x8 + x9*x9 + x10*x10)"
    },
    {
      "name": "x1_sq_minus_rest_sq_mean",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Squared x1 minus average of squared other features; contrast in variance contribution.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "contrast",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights when x1 dominates row variance, useful for linear separation boundaries.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "x1*x1 - (x2*x2 + x3*x3 + x4*x4 + x5*x5 + x6*x6 + x7*x7 + x8*x8 + x9*x9 + x10*x10) / 9.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "signed_x1_x2_x3_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Smooth weighted composite emphasizing the top three columns with decreasing weights.",
      "value_range": [-1.833, 1.833],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a hand-weighted linear projection focused on lower-index features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "1.0*x1 + 0.5*x2 + 0.333*x3"
    },
    {
      "name": "feature_dispersion_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of how dispersed the row values are: ratio of max absolute feature value to mean absolute feature value, capped, indicating whether the row is dominated by a single feature versus broadly distributed.",
      "value_range": [1.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_dispersion",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Helps linear SVM separate concentrated-signal rows from diffuse-signal rows.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.abs(x1), np.abs(x2)), np.maximum(np.abs(x3), np.abs(x4))), np.maximum(np.maximum(np.abs(x5), np.abs(x6)), np.maximum(np.abs(x7), np.abs(x8)))), np.maximum(np.abs(x9), np.abs(x10))) / ((np.abs(x1) + np.abs(x2) + np.abs(x3) + np.abs(x4) + np.abs(x5) + np.abs(x6) + np.abs(x7) + np.abs(x8) + np.abs(x9) + np.abs(x10)) / 10.0 + 0.001), 1.0, 10.0)"
    }
  ]
}
